MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Better and fairer care. Always.

We are St Vincent's Health Australia, Australia's largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services.

Founded by The Sisters of Charity in 1857, our +30,000 healthcare superheroes operate public and private hospitals, residential aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs.

About the role

Be part of a busy and collaborative team providing first and second-level technical support for computer systems, software, and hardware issues, both remotely and face-to-face. Troubleshoot, monitor, and restore personal computers and devices connected to the network

Deliver high-quality client service, managing issues with integrity, compassion, and timely resolution

Work from various sites across our Hospital and Aged Care network in QLD to resolve technical incidents

Participate in the after-hours on-call roster

About you

Current Australian driver's license and reliable vehicle is a MUST Certificate IV in Information Technology Support (or equivalent experience)

Minimum 3+ years' experience in field engineering, desktop support or IT technical roles

Strong knowledge and skills in PC hardware and associated devices

Good understanding and associated skills in networking

Experience supporting AV systems, nurse call, telephony and comms room infrastructure

Working knowledge of Cisco, VoIP, DECT and Analog Phone setup and configuration

Must be able to commit to fulltime hours, including after-hours on-call requirements as detailed above

Why work at St Vincent's?

Join us on our mission to provide care to all, including the most at-risk people in our community

Discounted access to many gyms for you and your family with Fitness Passport

Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank

Access to a salary sacrifice program (smart salary). Make a proportion of your salary tax-free!

Committed to financial support for educational development, scholarship programs, paid study leave

Sponsorship - work rights for Australia

Please note, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For this role you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or have an Australia visa that grants you the work rights necessary for the role.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role-required pre-employment checks, including relevant immunisations.

Equal opportunity

We celebrate diversity & inclusion and are committed to equal employment opportunity for everyone.

How to apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting how your interest, skills, and experience align with the role.

Respectfully, this role is not open to recruitment agencies.

29 June 2027 11:59pm

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven ICT Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects across our organisation. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership capabilities, a solid understanding of ICT systems and infrastructure, and a proven ability to manage competing priorities within budget and timeline constraints. This role suits a results-oriented professional who thrives in dynamic environments and can effectively bridge technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Plan, organise, and oversee end-to-end delivery of ICT projects, ensuring milestones, objectives, and deliverables are met within agreed timeframes and budgets
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to address those requirements effectively
Formulate and contribute to ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with broader business goals and digital transformation initiatives
Direct the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT resources, including software, hardware, and infrastructure, and coordinate relevant user training programmes
Manage project resources, scheduling, and task prioritisation, allocating team members and contractors to maximise efficiency and project outcomes
Set priorities across system development, maintenance, and operational activities, balancing short-term demands with long-term strategic objectives
Oversee the security and integrity of ICT systems, ensuring compliance with organisational policies, data governance frameworks, and relevant legislative requirements
Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies and escalating where necessary to ensure continuity of delivery
Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk registers, and post-implementation reviews
Liaise with internal stakeholders, vendors, and third-party service providers to manage expectations, resolve impediments, and maintain clear lines of communication throughout the project lifecycle
Monitor project budgets, track expenditure, and provide regular financial reporting to senior leadership and governance committees
Champion continuous improvement by conducting lessons-learnt reviews and embedding better practices across the project delivery function
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience (typically 3–5 years) managing ICT projects of varying scale and complexity within a corporate or government environment
Proficiency in project management methodologies such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum frameworks
Strong understanding of ICT infrastructure, software development lifecycles, systems integration, and enterprise technology environments
Proven ability to manage budgets, resource plans, and project schedules using tools such as MS Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management
Experience preparing and presenting project governance documentation, business cases, and status reports to senior leadership
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage vendor relationships effectively
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data privacy obligations, and relevant Australian regulatory frameworks
Preferred Qualifications
PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned service environments
Experience delivering projects within Agile or hybrid delivery models
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience in change management practices and supporting organisational technology transitions
Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) or large-scale system implementation projects
Prior experience working within highly regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
Why Join Us?
Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote options, supporting a healthy work-life balance
Ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications, training programmes, and industry conference access
A collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values innovation, continuous improvement, and diverse perspectives
Access to an employee benefits programme including wellness initiatives, additional leave options, and corporate discounts
Meaningful work contributing to impactful technology projects that drive real organisational and community outcomes
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

They use the latest technology to o er fast, accurate and high-quality workmanship to minimise down time and increase productivity and efficiency for their clients. Werner Engineering is locally owned Mackay-based machining and fabrication workshop, specialising the manufacture and repair of parts for the mining, transport, sugar, agricultural and local industries

Werner Engineering is looking for MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis

The role includes but is not limited to:
Maintaining and repairing equipment.
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment.
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors.
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance.
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment.
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials.
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line.
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations.
Troubleshooting mechanical issues.
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation.
Supports improvement projects.

Controls downtime by preforming routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures.
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed.
Understand customer change request and provide schedule

To be considered for this role you must have:
Strong mechanical knowledge on a wide variety of vehicle and equipment
Mechanical Technician trade qualification or equivalent
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong diagnostic abilities
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

result.description:
Sunup Farm at Spring Creek, Queensland, is a certified organic horticultural grower that cultivates and supplies fresh produce to markets across the region. The business runs the full growing cycle in house, from crop production and irrigation through to harvesting, packing and dispatch, and holds organic certification across a broad range of vegetable and fruit lines. With a firm commitment to product quality, workplace safety, sustainable growing practices and employment within the regional community, Sunup Farm is looking for an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to join the team. As Sunup Farm continues to grow and to uphold the standards behind its certifications, we are bringing quality assurance and food safety under dedicated leadership. Reporting to management, the Quality Assurance Manager will take ownership of the systems, standards and everyday checks that keep our produce safe, consistent and compliant, from the paddock through to the packing shed and on to our customers.

In this role you will:
•	Build and maintain the farm's quality assurance and food safety management systems, so every line of produce consistently meets the standards our customers and certifiers expect.
•	Identify the food safety standards, organic certification requirements and regulatory codes that apply to our operation, and turn them into clear, practical operating procedures the team can follow each day.
•	Set quality objectives and workable plans that keep customers satisfied while making efficient use of the farm's people, water, inputs and equipment.
•	Plan and run internal audits, and coordinate external and certification audits, so the business stays inspection ready throughout the year.
•	Use quality checks, data and monitoring tools to track produce quality from the field through grading, packing and dispatch, and step in quickly when results drift outside acceptable limits.
•	Investigate non-conformances, quality issues and customer complaints, identify the root cause, and put corrective and preventive actions in place so problems do not recur.
•	Keep quality documentation, records and reporting systems accurate and current, including full batch traceability from paddock to customer.
•	Oversee hygiene, sanitation and safe food-handling practices across the packing shed, cool rooms and produce-handling areas, and keep cleaning and pest-control programmes on track.
•	Carry out pre-harvest and post-harvest inspections and product grading, confirming that fruit and vegetables meet quality specifications before they are packed and shipped.
•	Monitor storage and cool-chain conditions so freshness and shelf life are protected from harvest right through to delivery.
•	Maintain records of approved inputs and treatment activity in line with organic certification, and verify that incoming materials and supplier products meet our requirements.
•	Review how we grow, harvest, pack and dispatch, looking for practical improvements to systems, processes and workflows that lift consistency and reduce waste.
•	Train and support farm and packing staff on quality procedures, food safety and compliance, building good practice into everyday work.
•	Act as the main point of contact on quality matters for management, auditors, regulators and customers, keeping each informed on performance and compliance.
